note: Every feature is EXPLORATORY_NOT_VALIDATED. Availability: PRE_DELIVERY means computable from earlier rows only; PARTIAL_PRE_DELIVERY uses data that was not all known at the delivery (descriptive only); OUTCOME_OF_DELIVERY and the denominator flags depend on delivery k itself; POST_INNINGS and POST_MATCH are forbidden as inputs.

features.name: team_runs_before
features.formula: R_k = sum of total runs of rows < k
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: team_wickets_before
features.definition: Wickets fallen before delivery k (is_wicket flag)
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)
features.handling_note: Uses the is_wicket flag. Wicket-flag disagreements (RULE_DISMISSED_NO_FLAG) are reported through team_wickets_alt_before, not by dropping rows

features.name: team_wickets_alt_before
features.definition: Wickets before k counting rows with a dismissed player
features.formula: W_alt_k = count(is_wicket OR dismissed_player_id notnull) over rows < k
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: wickets_remaining_alt
features.definition: Wickets in hand under the alternative wicket count

features.name: legal_balls_bowled_before
features.formula: B_k = sum(legal_inc) over rows < k; legal_inc = is_legal_ball AND extras_type <> Penalty
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)
features.leakage_risk: none (denominator flag of EARLIER rows only)
features.handling_note: RULE_EXTRAS_PENALTY: Penalty never counts. Unknown extras keep their own category

features.name: innings_limit_balls
features.formula: L = 120, or the revised limit (in balls) for DLS innings
features.leakage_risk: PARTIAL for revised limits: the announcement ball is unknown

features.name: over_k
features.handling_note: Derived from legal balls, never from overid or over_ball_num

features.name: ball_in_over_k
features.definition: Legal ball position inside the over

features.name: innings_phase
features.formula: from B_k and L under the phase rule in config/pressure_rules_v1.json

features.name: target
features.formula: T = innings-1 total + 1, or revised_target for DLS
features.leakage_risk: none for unrevised; PARTIAL for revised (final target, not target at ball k)

features.name: req_nonpositive_flag
features.handling_note: RRR is NULL when this flag is true

features.name: rrr
features.formula: 6 * Req_k / Brem_k (NULL if Brem_k = 0, no target or Req_k <= 0)

features.name: projected_surplus
features.definition: Projected finish at current rate minus target

features.name: resource_ratio
features.definition: Resources left: balls and wickets share

features.name: dls_flag
features.definition: Row belongs to an innings with a revised limit or target
features.formula: revised fields non-null for the innings

features.name: dls_match_flag
features.formula: any of revised_target, first_inn_revised_overs, second_inn_revised_overs non-null

features.name: dls_fields_complete
features.definition: Revised target and both revised limits are stated

features.name: innings_limit_unstated
features.definition: Revised innings without a stated limit
features.formula: revised match, limit NULL for this innings

features.name: limit_applied_from_start_assumed
features.leakage_risk: hindsight for rows before the interruption

features.name: dls_exclude_primary
features.definition: Row left out of primary populations because the revised state is not reconstructable

features.name: target_basis_unverified
features.formula: innings 1 incomplete or has revised fields

features.name: state_wicket_flag_disagreement
features.definition: Wicket flag and dismissed-player disagree in earlier rows
features.formula: any earlier row with dismissed_player_id and NOT is_wicket
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: restricted_innings_flag
features.handling_note: RULE_INNINGS_3_4: excluded from regulation-pressure metrics; source rows preserved

features.name: batter_balls_faced_before
features.definition: Striker balls faced earlier in innings
features.formula: sum(counts_as_ball_faced) over earlier rows for the striker
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)
features.handling_note: RULE_EXTRAS_PENALTY: Penalty not a ball faced

features.name: batter_runs_before
features.formula: sum(batter_runs) over earlier rows for the striker
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: bowler_deliveries_before
features.formula: count of earlier rows by the bowler
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: bowler_legal_balls_before
features.formula: sum(legal_inc) over earlier rows by the bowler
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: bowler_runs_charged_before
features.definition: Runs charged to the bowler earlier
features.formula: sum(charged runs) over earlier rows (batter_runs + wide/Overstep/other primary extras)
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: bowler_wickets_credited_before
features.formula: count of earlier Caught/Bowled/LBW/Stump/Hit Wicket rows
inputs: deliveries (rows before this one in the same innings)

features.name: season_label
features.definition: Season key from competitions.season and match_date

features.name: par_runs_lomo
features.definition: Par score at this state, other matches (LOMO)
